brand.name: Utkarsh Corporation
brand.domain: Ayurvedic e-commerce, herbal medicines, wellness, health camps
brand.tone: trustworthy, natural, rooted in Indian Ayurvedic tradition, premium, editorial
brand.mission: Helping every person progress toward better health. Local for Vocal.

headings.strategy: Used for hero texts, section titles, and mission statements. Must be tracking-tight for larger sizes to feel editorial and premium. Reflects ancient wisdom and heritage.

body.strategy: Clean, highly readable sans-serif for product descriptions, navigation, and functional UI. Provides a modern counterbalance to the traditional headings.

color_palette.strategy: Nature Distilled. Cream/Off-white base (#F9F6F0) with Deep Forest Green (#1A3626) for structure/text. Mustard Gold (#C5A059) for key actions, trust badges, and highlights. Warm brown (#5C4033) for subtle accents.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Anti-grid fluid flow mixed with structured Bento blocks for categories. Generous white space (p-8 to p-16) to allow products to breathe.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 bg-[#1A3626] text-[#F9F6F0] hover:bg-[#2C4C3B] transition-colors duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 bg-transparent border border-[#1A3626] text-[#1A3626] hover:bg-[#1A3626]/5 transition-colors duration-300 font-medium

components.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#1A3626]/10 overflow-hidden
components.inputs: bg-white border border-[#1A3626]/20 focus:border-[#1A3626] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1A3626] outline-none py-2 px-3 rounded-lg transition-all
components.badges: rounded-full bg-[#C5A059]/10 text-[#5C4033] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle scale-up (scale-105) for images in product cards, slight opacity shifts for text links.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling. Parallax effects on background leaf textures.

hero_images.description: Person grinding herbs in mortar and pestle. Perfect for Hero section background or About mission.
Wooden mortar and pestle overhead shot. Great for ingredient storytelling or 'Local for Vocal' section.

product_images.description: White bottle of medicine. Supplement product thumbnail for Shop Grid.
Minimal white bottle, clean background. Use for Skin Care or Immunity category.
Bottle with herbal pills scattered. Ideal for Product Detail Page gallery.

textures_and_backgrounds.description: Palm leaves texture. Use as subtle background divider or footer background with low opacity.
Macro green leaf texture. Good for category cards (e.g., Skin Care).

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case format based on their role, e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-form-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: JavaScript ONLY: Use .jsx/.js extensions for React components. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) as this project uses JavaScript.
Icons: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons (cart, search, user account, whatsapp).

UI Library: Use Shadcn UI for forms, selects, and dialogs. Heavily customize them to remove the default Vercel-look by applying the #1A3626 / #F9F6F0 color palette, rounded-2xl radii, and earthy spacing.
Hero Overlay: The Hero section overlay must be minimal, e.g., bg-[#1A3626]/40 or a gentle gradient, ensuring the background imagery breathes while maintaining text contrast.
Layouts: Use BENTO grid layouts for category shortcuts on the homepage. Let images of roots/leaves break rigid grids.
Testing: Incorporate 'data-testid' on all buttons, forms, and key interaction points unconditionally.
Header: Sticky header with 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80', containing Logo (Cormorant Garamond text or SVG), Search bar, Cart icon, and Account icon.
Contact: Create a Floating WhatsApp button fixed to the bottom right on all customer-facing pages.
Admin: The Admin dashboard should follow the 'Organic & Earthy' color scheme but structured tightly using Shadcn tables and card components for Data correlation.
